features.name: deployment_scale_bucket
features.description: Ordinal footprint tier from site count and prevalence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns very skewed footprint measures into small ordinal splits for broad-versus-narrow deployment patterns.

features.name: cname_subdomain_complexity
features.description: Ordinal complexity tier for DNS-style indirection and subdomain spread.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights rows with CNAME use plus many subdomains, a combination trees can isolate with one split.

features.name: transparency_gap_count
features.description: Count of missing public owner and privacy-policy signals; 0 means both present, 2 means neither present.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a simple monotonic split for opaque versus transparent entries.

features.name: resource_volume_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucket for total resource observations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses heavy-tailed resource counts into stable thresholds.

features.name: active_request_mix_ratio
features.description: Clipped share of resources represented by scripts or fetches.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes active-code and resource-request mix as a bounded nonlinear interaction.

features.name: cookie_persistence_bucket
features.description: Ordinal lifetime tier based on maximum cookie time-to-live in days: none, sub-day, day-plus, month-plus, year-plus.
features.expected_model_benefit: Lets trees split directly on persistence horizons.

features.name: cookie_exchange_bucket
features.description: Ordinal cookie activity tier using sent-cookie volume, first-party cookie volume, and observed cookie prevalence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines sparse cookie signals into one split-friendly severity measure.

features.name: api_volume_bucket
features.description: Ordinal volume bucket for total API calls.
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms a highly skewed count into direct thresholds.

features.name: api_family_breadth_count
features.description: Number of semantic API families with any observed use.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures breadth across browser surfaces without relying on hundreds of sparse individual flags.
features.formula: np.where(canvas_api_count > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(audio_api_count > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(navigator_api_count > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(screen_api_count > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(device_api_count > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(storage_api_count > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(timing_api_count > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(media_api_count > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(webrtc_api_count > 0, 1, 0)

features.name: fingerprinting_strength_bucket
features.description: Ordinal strength tier combining row fingerprinting scores, resource fingerprinting maximum, weighted score, and API diversity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Makes high-intensity fingerprinting patterns available as a compact split.

features.name: browser_surface_semantic_level
features.description: Ordinal 0-4 assessor score from only the row's API names, API counts, API family counts, and fingerprinting fields: 0 no meaningful browser-surface use, 1 generic environment reads, 2 several high-entropy browser properties, 3 canvas/audio/WebGL/device/screen probing, 4 probing plus unusually high API volume or storage/cookie activity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a human-readable ordinal summary of intent-like API patterns that sparse formula counts may miss.

features.name: infrastructure_semantic_level
features.description: Ordinal 0-4 assessor score from prevalence, sites, subdomain_count, has_cnames, resource_count, resource_type_count, owner, and policy indicators: 0 isolated and transparent, 1 small footprint, 2 moderate multi-site or CNAME footprint, 3 broad footprint with transparency gaps, 4 very broad footprint with CNAMEs/subdomains/resources suggesting embedded third-party infrastructure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives trees a compact semantic grouping for footprint and transparency combinations.
